key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable drag-to-snap zones and edge snapping

key.name: default-layout
key.summary: Layout applied to workspaces without an explicit layout

key.name: snap-layout
key.summary: Zones shown when dragging with the snap modifier on a floating workspace

key.name: workspace-layouts
key.summary: Per workspace:monitor layout and tile ratios (JSON, managed by the extension)

key.name: outer-gap
key.summary: Margin between tiles and the screen edge in pixels

key.name: edge-snap
key.summary: Snap windows dragged to screen edges and corners

key.name: snap-modifier
key.summary: Hold while dragging a window to show the snap zones

key.name: layout-none
key.summary: Turn tiling off for the current workspace

key.name: cycle-layout
key.summary: Cycle layouts on the current workspace

key.name: swap-left
key.summary: Swap focused window with the tile on the left

key.name: swap-right
key.summary: Swap focused window with the tile on the right

key.name: swap-up
key.summary: Swap focused window with the tile above

key.name: swap-down
key.summary: Swap focused window with the tile below

key.name: toggle-float
key.summary: Float or re-tile the focused window
